data.name: Muzaini
data.gender_notes: Muzaini is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic roots 'azana' (intelligence) and 'na' (to give), Muzaini means one who is intelligent, wise and brave. This name is often given to boys who are expected to grow up to be wise leaders, scholars and warriors. The name Muzaini carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Malay. Parents who choose Muzaini usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzaini total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name also evokes the bravery and courage required to face the trials and tribulations of life, and to persevere in the face of hardships, especially in the pursuit of truth and righteousness.
